name: Bead
author: Erin Carter
description: A sparse constellation of large condensation droplets on near-black glass, each thick water lens trapping a sharp inverted miniature of an unseen neon sign. Drops swell on their own clocks, occasionally merge with a quick wobble, and plunge off the bottom leaving a brief wet line while a new bead condenses elsewhere.

params.label: Drop size
params.effect: Mean radius in CSS pixels of the droplet lenses, from marble-sized beads to heavy drops with clearly readable inverted signs inside.

params.label: Lifecycle rate
params.effect: How quickly drops swell toward merges and plunges; 0 holds the constellation in glinting stasis, 2 keeps a merge or fall happening somewhere every few seconds.

params.label: Sign flicker
params.effect: Raggedness of the neon glyphs' flicker inside the drops; 0 burns every tiny sign steady, 1 lets them sputter like failing tubes.

params.label: Glint
params.effect: Brightness of each droplet's crescent rim highlight, from matte fog beads to sharply lit glass pearls.
